name: Python
description: The most versatile language in the ecosystem. Python powers data science, machine learning, backend systems, automation, and scripting. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python (3rd Ed.)
items.description: The premier beginner resource for learning practical scripting to automate everyday tasks.

items.title: Think Python (3rd Edition)
items.description: Completely redesigned for modern learning. Runs in Jupyter notebooks — read, execute code, and work through exercises directly in the browser.

items.title: Dive Into Python 3
items.description: A free book for experienced programmers to learn Python 3 quickly. Covers native datatypes, comprehensions, closures, generators, and testing.

items.title: The Python Tutorial
items.description: Curated by the core developers and PSF. The definitive resource for understanding the language syntax, standard library, and data structures.

items.title: Python Language Reference
items.description: The complete reference for Python syntax, lexical analysis, data model, execution model, and import system.

items.title: Python Standard Library
items.description: The built-in library reference covering everything from string operations to networking, threading, and web frameworks.

items.title: Google's Python Class
items.description: Free class from Google engineers with lecture videos, written materials, and code exercises covering regex, utilities, and more.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Python Curriculum
items.description: Completely free, project-based curriculum with browser-based coding environments and certifications for Python.

items.title: Python for Beginners — Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A multi-hour comprehensive video tutorial covering core concepts, loops, dictionaries, classes, and mini-projects.

items.title: PyCon US Talks (YouTube)
items.description: Hundreds of free conference talks from Python core contributors, software architects, and library maintainers.

items.title: Exercism — Python Track
items.description: 100% free platform with 146 coding exercises across 17 concepts. Includes automated code analysis and human mentor feedback.

items.title: Codewars
items.description: Master Python by solving bite-sized community-crafted challenges and comparing solutions with other developers.

items.title: HackerRank — Python Track
items.description: Domain-specific challenges from basic I/O to advanced data structures and interview preparation.

items.title: Real Python Cheat Sheet
items.description: Compact, exhaustive reference covering syntax, data types, collections, control flow, functions, and file I/O.

items.title: Python Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference for Python 3 syntax, built-in functions, comprehensions, and common patterns.

items.title: PyCoder's Weekly
items.description: A premier weekly email newsletter highlighting the best Python articles, tutorials, open-source projects, and community news.

items.title: Python.org — Latest News
items.description: Official Python Software Foundation blog covering release announcements, PEP summaries, and community updates.

items.title: Reddit r/learnpython
items.description: The largest community of Python learners and educators.

items.title: Stack Overflow — Python Tag
items.description: The definitive Q&A forum for Python questions — from beginner syntax to advanced metaprogramming patterns.

items.title: Python Discord
items.description: A large, active Python community on Discord with channels for learning, projects, and career advice.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of Python
lessons.description: Core concepts, syntax, and first steps with Python
